text:
incident-bot: Pager alert triggered: prod-gateway high 5xx rate (>12% over baseline) and TLS handshake failures reported by edge proxies. Severity: P1. Links: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/2439876543 :rotating_light:

jamie.ops: I'm seeing spikes from the US-east frontends — 502/523/525 in the logs. Confirming oncall.

maria-sre: oncall here, looking. Can someone post a sample proxy error?

alex-platform: pasted a quick tail from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-14T09:12:01Z ERR tls_handshake_failed peer=10.2.4.7 err="x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid (possibly: X509_V_ERR_CERT_HAS_EXPIRED)"
2026-03-14T09:12:02Z ERR upstream_connect 502 peer=svc-inference-1 msg="handshake failure"
```
Seems like the intermediate cert rotated but the bundle on some edge hosts is still old.

jamie.ops: @alex-platform good catch. Any origin changes recently to cert chain?

alex-platform: We rotated the intermediate yesterday for compliance, rollout was supposed to be staged. Looks like ~20% of edge proxies didn't pick up the new chain — some agents failed to restart.

oncall-rotator: handing to maria-sre (primary) -> jamie.ops (secondary). @maria-sre are you taking lead?

maria-sre: taking lead. Quick customer impact check: is traffic failing for all regions?

support-frontend: reporting an uptick in 502 for EU and US clients, APAC mostly ok. Chat threads show some enterprise customers seeing retries/timeouts.

evelyn-ps: flagged to account execs, low-latency customers seeing degraded request success. No data exfil or auth failures.

jamie.ops: mitigation plan idea: 1) divert new sessions to healthy region (APAC) for non-regulated traffic 2) soft-fail mTLS verification on edge for a short window to allow traffic 3) force-restart agent on stale hosts 4) push corrected chain to hosts that failed. Thoughts?

maria-sre: we can't broadly disable mTLS verification for enterprise customers. Suggest: 1) failover route for non-enterprise traffic to APAC/eu-backup 2) quick reload of cert bundle on edges that show old fingerprint 3) temp traffic steering by gateway policy.

alex-platform: I can run a query to find hosts with old fingerprint. Command I'm running:
```
# list hosts with old cert fingerprint
ssh ops@edge-head && sudo grep -R "SHA256:OLD_FP" /etc/ssl/certs || true
```
Found ~34 hosts failing to update.

jamie.ops: Can you push a restart to those hosts? I'll prepare a safe service restart patch.

deploy-bot: Auto-deploy triggered: ops/edge-cert-reload v2026.03.14-hotfix -> starting rollout to failed-hosts subset. CI: green.

alex-platform: starting parallel restart with `--graceful` to avoid connection drops. Using concurrency=4.

maria-sre: while that's happening, can someone verify the cert chain with openssl from the failing region? Example command:
```
openssl s_client -connect prod-gateway-us-east-1:443 -showcerts
```

jamie.ops: sample output from a failing host:
```
subject=/CN=prod-gateway
issuer=/CN=old-intermediate
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
```
So leaf is fine but chain references old intermediate.

support-frontend: switching non-sensitive traffic to backup-eu pool now (route override). Doing gradual shift 10% -> 50% over 5m.

evelyn-ps: emailing affected customers now. Keeping them updated every 15m.

oncall-rotator: reminder: escalate if >30% of prod capacity affected or SLA violations hit.

alex-platform: restart progress: 18/34 hosts done, 8 currently restarting, 8 pending. Error on host edge-12: service failed to start due to file permission on cert store. Investigating.

jamie.ops: edge-12 fix: `chown root:ssl /etc/ssl/certs/chain.pem && systemctl restart edge-proxy` fixed it. Marking as done.

maria-sre: good. Continue rollout. Also enable temporary increased logging on gateway to capture any residual handshake failures: set log level DEBUG for tls module.

incident-bot: status update: mitigation in progress. Current 5xx rate down from 12.8% -> 4.2% in last 6m.

support-frontend: customer impact reduced. few lingering retries still hitting enterprise flows — likely pinned to specific backend path.

jamie.ops: quick check: any cert rotation automation failures in the rollout system? We should file a postmortem if config drift caused partial rollout.

alex-platform: initial investigation: rollout agent upgraded yesterday; some hosts had old agent version which didn't support new atomic file write for chain.pem. That's why some didn't pick up new intermediate.

maria-sre: action items so far: 1) complete forced reload on remaining hosts 2) temporary routing for non-regulated traffic 3) create incident ticket and start postmortem 4) notify legal/security if any compliance scope affected.

deploy-bot: rollout complete to targeted hosts. Verification checks: cert fingerprint now matches NEW_FP on 34/34 hosts.

incident-bot: Observability noted handshake errors falling to baseline. 5xx rate now 0.9%. Mark as mitigated.

evelyn-ps: sent follow-up to customers: "issue mitigated, root cause suspected partial rollout due to agent version mismatch; we'll share RCA soon."

maria-sre: beginning post-incident tasks: assign owners for RCA (alex-platform), remediation (jamie.ops), and communication (evelyn-ps). Please capture timelines, config diffs, and agent versions.

jamie.ops: copy. Also scheduling a targeted rolling upgrade to ensure agent parity across fleet and adding CI gate for chain rotation automation.

alex-platform: will dump the rollout logs and upload to the incident ticket. Quick snippet will include `agent-version` per host.

oncall-rotator: handing off to morning shift, incident officially mitigated. If new handshake spikes reappear, reopen pager. Good job team :tada:.

support-frontend: closing customer-facing incident banner in 30m if no regressions.

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. Closing pager window. Remember to fill out the postmortem template and attach logs: https://ops.redwood.internal/runs/2439876543/rca
